stem: Which one of the following statements is not correct ?

options.A: According to Gentlemen agreement, future recruitment to services will be on the basis of population from both sides.
options.B: G.O. 610 was issued to rectify the lapses in implementing the Presidential order and injustice meted out to Telangana people.
options.C: According to the Gentlemen agreement the Cabinet will consist of members in proportion of 50 : 50 for Andhra and Telangana respectively.
options.D: In 1953 the Government of India constituted State Re-organisation Commission under the Chairmanship of Justice Fazal Ali.
